# apple_app_asset_library_image (Resource)

Uploads an image (PNG or JPEG) to an app's App Asset Library, for `apple_app_asset_library_placement` to show. A changed file is uploaded as a new asset, which replaces the resource and its placements. Destroying the resource deletes the asset, which must have no placements left. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`; the next apply then uploads the configured file, because App Store Connect doesn't report a checksum to compare.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_asset_library_image" "home" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  file           = "${path.module}/screenshots/home.png"
  category       = "APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS"
  reference_name = "Home screen"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app. Changing it creates a new asset library image.
- `category` (String) Category: `APP_SCREENSHOTS_AND_PREVIEWS`, `CREATIVE_ASSETS`. Changing it uploads a new asset library image.
- `file` (String) Path of the file to upload. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.

### Optional

- `reference_name` (String) Name of the asset in the library.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the uploaded file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset library image.
- `spec_id` (String) ID of the asset specification App Store Connect matched the file to.
- `state` (String) State of the asset, e.g. `COMPLETE` once processed or `APPROVED` after review.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_asset_library_image.home
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    id     = "f4000005-e036-8f0b-8018-d259974bee61"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset library image.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_asset_library_image.home 1234567890/f4000005-e036-8f0b-8018-d259974bee61
```
